## Key Points

- Payment reconciliation runs daily against the channel settlement file, checking per-transaction amount and fee.
- Discrepancies enter the operations workbench: overpayments are returned by the channel, shortfalls trigger re-orders.
- Discrepancy SLA is two business days; overdue items escalate to the finance supervisor.
- A daily reconciliation report lists successful counts, discrepancy counts, and discrepancy amounts.

## Key Details

- 中文原名:支付对账流程;每日对账以渠道结算文件为准,差错单进入运营工作台。
